data.name: Josabeth
data.long_meaning: The name Josabeth is derived from the Hebrew words ‘Yosha’ meaning 'God will add' or 'God is salvation'. In the Bible, a woman named Josabeth is mentioned as a Levite's wife in 1 Chronicles 24:10. Her name signifies God's promise of adding or bestowing blessings upon His people.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing the faith and trust that God will add blessings to our lives.

in_hebrew.name: יושבת
in_hebrew.long_meaning: יושבת הוא שם עברי שמשמעותו 'אלוהים יושיע אותי בגדול' או 'הוא יושיע אותי'. השם מורכב משתי מילים: 'יוש' שפירושו 'אלוהים' ו'בת' שפירושו 'בתי' או 'בתול'. השם יושבת מופיע בתנ'ך כהשם של אמו של יהוא, מלך ישראל.

in_greek.name: Ιωσαβέθ
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι η σωτηρία μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Ιωσαβέθ είναι ένα ελληνικό όνομα που προέρχεται από το εβραϊκό 'יושבת' (Yoshevat). Σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι η σωτηρία μου' ή 'Ο Θεός θα με σώσει'. Στο Νέο Testament, το όνομα Ιωσαβέθ αναφέρεται ως η μητέρα του Ιεωά, βασιλιά του Ισραήλ.

in_latin.name: Josabeth
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Josabeth derivatur ex hebraeo 'יושבת' (Yoshevat), quod significat 'Deus est salus mea' vel 'Deus salvabit me'. In Ecclesia primitiva, nomen Josabeth fuit usitatum pro matre Iehu, regis Israelis.

in_english.name: Josabeth
in_english.meaning: God will save me or God is my salvation
in_english.long_meaning: The name Josabeth originates from the Hebrew 'יושבת' (Yoshevat), meaning 'God will save me' or 'God is my salvation'. It is derived from two Hebrew words: 'Yosh' (God) and 'bat' (daughter or salvation). In the Bible, Josabeth is mentioned as the mother of Jehu, a king of Israel (2 Kings 9:14-26, 10:28-36). The name Josabeth symbolizes spiritual salvation and divine protection. Throughout Christian tradition, Josabeth represents faith and trust in God's saving power. The name has been used across various Christian cultures, signifying a strong connection to biblical heritage.
